name: Bill Osburn

bio.statement: Osburn's pamphlet statement lists his background as a small business owner and education at Clackamas Community College in criminal justice.
bio.excerpt: OCHS / Rex Putnam, Diploma; CCC, Criminal Justice, AGS

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Osburn says his top priority is making the city more affordable by lowering the tax burden.
positions.excerpt: my top priority is making our city more affordable by lowering your tax burden.

positions.statement: Osburn's pamphlet statement says any new taxes or fees proposed in the future would be put to a public vote.
positions.excerpt: I will also ensure that any new taxes or fees proposed in the future will be put to a vote of the people.

positions.statement: Osburn's pamphlet statement says he would review every city department, cut spending he calls wasteful and eliminate unnecessary programs.
positions.excerpt: I will immediately review every city department, cut wasteful spending, and eliminate unnecessary programs

positions.statement: In an OPB questionnaire for his May 2026 county commission run, Osburn said government should not be building houses.
positions.excerpt: Government never does anything at a competitive price, so I don’t believe we should be building houses,

source.publisher: OPB (candidate questionnaire, Clackamas County Commissioner Position 4 primary)

positions.statement: In the same OPB questionnaire, Osburn said any ambulance provider should meet expected response times.
positions.excerpt: Any company that is providing services like this should meet the expected response times.

source.publisher: OPB (candidate questionnaire, Clackamas County Commissioner Position 4 primary)
